design.name: 熔心大剑
design.role: 熔心魔将的双手大剑（Unity 资产 SM_BossWeapon_Greatsword，独立挂件，挂本体 socket_sword）
design.brief: A colossal straight double-edged Chinese greatsword about 3.2 m long: a 2.4 x 0.42 m blade of dark purple-grey basalt-steel with a raised central ridge, one molten-orange line along the ridge ending in medium-scale cloud scrolls near the guard, burnished copper edge bands on both edges; a copper beast-face guard with two short downward horns and a round furnace-heart disc; a long two-handed grip wrapped in ink-black cord with copper ferrules; a round copper pommel.
design.note: 2026-11-01 用户：大剑单独用 Tripo 建模，概念图要给用户看
